title: FBI Agents Search Eric Swalwell’s Home as Part of Federal Sexual Assault Inquiry
summary: Most sex crimes are prosecuted by state and local authorities. The federal agents appeared to be using civil rights statutes to scrutinize Mr. Swalwell’s conduct, a person familiar with the case said.
